title: MITgcm configuration for coastal-trapped waves generated at Sebastián Vizcaíno Bay (SVB_CTW)
description: MITgcm (checkpoint69k-11-gdecd05a68) configuration, namelists, input-generation and analysis scripts for wind-forced coastal-trapped-wave experiments with and without Sebastián Vizcaíno Bay (realistic and smoothed bathymetries). Model output is not included.
